notablePrerequisites: Wormfang Manta doesn't have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Gossip's Talent. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
